## What we use

Frequency range (150–960 MHz), maximum output power (+22 dBm), sensitivity
(−148 dBm best case), and the absence of any Semtech LoRa part above 2.5 GHz
(closes C10). Restated in SPEC-003 and `vendor/summary/semtech.md`.
